name: Autonomous Data-Driven Insights Pipeline
description: End-to-end ML analytics pipeline: EDA profiling, feature engineering, statistical hypothesis testing, SHAP model explainability, and executive insight synthesis with a model card.
author: agent-foundry

acceptance_criteria: Data Quality Report generated with overall quality score
Missingness mechanisms (MCAR/MAR/MNAR) classified for all columns
Leakage risk columns flagged before any feature engineering
Outlier bounds computed per column using IQR or Z-score
All periodic datetime columns encoded with sin/cos projection
High-cardinality categoricals encoded with smoothed target encoding (fitted on train only)
Missing indicator columns added for MNAR-suspect features
Feature Engineering Audit table generated documenting all transformations
SRM check performed and passed before any significance testing
Test type selected from decision tree (parametric vs non-parametric) based on normality
Effect size (Cohen's d) computed alongside p-value
Multiple comparison correction (BH-FDR) applied to all secondary metrics
TreeSHAP explainer selected for tree model (not slower KernelSHAP)
Global beeswarm plot generated showing feature importance with direction
Local waterfall plots generated for 3 representative instances (correct, incorrect, edge-case)
Fairness audit run on all sensitive attributes; disparity ratio computed
Every finding uses the 4-part Insight Architecture (Finding → Context → Impact → Action)
Model Card generated with fairness audit summary
Executive brief scannable in < 60 seconds with KPI summary table
All claims linked to supporting statistical evidence (p-values, effect sizes, SHAP rankings)
